scope: SIMULATED development on nine previously inspected scenes; not holdout and not physical validation
purpose: Test whether triangulating all registered XYZ returns from four archived translated views before rasterization improves total support and volume error compared with per-view R005 grids fused by median.

control.algorithm: R005 per-view local TIN followed by conventional cellwise median

candidate.registration: Use decoded world XYZ supplied by each frame pose; pool all usable returns before one XY triangulation.
candidate.merge_rule: Round XY to the nearest fixed 0.5 mm bin in deterministic order. Retain median measured XYZ only when observed Z range is <= 0.003 m; otherwise withhold the cluster as a conflict.
candidate.triangulation: scipy.spatial.Delaunay over merged XY with qhull_options Qbb Qc Qz Q12; simplices sorted deterministically before rasterization
candidate.raster: Same grid centers, known base subtraction, below-reference threshold and barycentric interpolation conventions as server.geometry; average multiple accepted triangle contributions per cell.
candidate.total_eligibility: 400/400 supported cells, zero invalid frames, zero unavailable input views, no Qhull error and no input points omitted in Delaunay.coplanar

novelty_check: Existing E0-E4, P001-P004, R005-R006 and D001 rasterize each view independently or fit a declared shape/plane. None pool registered raw XYZ from multiple views before one global triangulation. No height sweep or new acquisition is included.

assessment.candidate_gate: All nine scenes must produce eligible total volume with absolute relative error <= 0.05 before R007 may be prepared.
assessment.partial_policy: Unsupported cells are never zero-filled; partial estimates are not approved totals.
domains: same-scene intersection of R005 and D003 support
whole box only for eligible totals
unsupported exact volume in evaluator only
metrics: total signed and absolute volume error
integrated absolute cell-volume error and cancellation ratio
support cells and exact missing volume in evaluator only
merge conflicts and accepted/rejected triangle counts
single local processing time, descriptive only

interpretation_limits: All scenes and acquisitions were previously inspected; this is development evidence, not independent validation.
Global Delaunay can join points across a discontinuity or occluded gap even when every triangle edge is <=0.10 m.
The 3 mm merge-conflict threshold is an engineering assumption, not calibrated uncertainty.
Pooling, cross-view merge and global triangulation are one bundled intervention; this experiment does not causally separate their effects.
TIN support is interpolation support, not directly observed area.
Ideal center rays omit finite-zone optics, noise, multipath and hardware effects.
A low net total error can result from cancellation and must be read with integrated absolute spatial error.

documentation.note: Current SciPy documentation confirms Delaunay.coplanar records input points omitted by numerical degeneracy; D003 abstains rather than enabling QJ perturbation.
